findings.explanation: Your payment is conditional upon receiving a tax exemption approval from the tax authority and can be delayed indefinitely without constituting a breach.
findings.suggested_change: Payments shall be made when due in accordance with the agreed payment terms.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to get started and have a minor suggestion before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause concerning tax exemptions, the current terms tie payment to a tax approval process that could cause indefinite delays. I propose modifying this so that payments shall be made when due in accordance with the agreed payment terms. Thank you for your time and understanding.
